case=hinges|hist=|screen=home@1024x640.text: The portal’s home page. I click Past orders.
case=hinges|hist=|screen=home@1024x640.note: Aims at the middle of the Past orders tile.

case=hinges|hist=click:tile-signout:ok|s.text: The portal signed me out, so I can’t re-order. I stop here.
case=hinges|hist=click:tile-signout:ok|s.note: The click landed on Sign out: the run ends with nothing ordered.

case=hinges|hist=click:tile-orders:ok|sc.text: I find PO-5531 in the list and click its Reorder link.
case=hinges|hist=click:tile-orders:ok|sc.note: Aims at the middle of the small Reorder link.

case=hinges|hist=click:tile-orders:ok,cl.text: The basket holds Brass hinge 3in × 120. I click Checkout.
